market_question: Will France send warships through the Strait of Hormuz by May 31, 2026?
reasoning: France maintains a permanent naval presence in the region, regularly transiting the Strait of Hormuz with frigates and support vessels for operations like EUNAVFOR Agenor. The market’s broad definition (including cargo/support vessels) makes a transit all but certain within a year, yet the price implies a negligible chance, representing a massive mispricing.
evidence_points: France participates in the European-led Agenor mission directly monitoring shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
French naval vessels routinely rotate through the French naval base in Abu Dhabi, often transiting the Strait.
Even routine resupply or logistics movements by French military support vessels would satisfy the resolution criteria.
sources_consulted: French Navy deployment patterns in Indian Ocean/Persian Gulf, 2024-2025
